perspectives.risk_summary: The high-confidence 'SELL' signal is viewed as a tactical opportunity to realize profits ahead of a minor, short-term pullback. This maneuver aims to create a more favorable re-entry point, optimizing the cost basis for the next leg up. The primary risk is missing immediate upside if the pullback does not materialize.

hedging_ideas: Buy short-dated, out-of-the-money call options to retain upside exposure while the core position is reduced.
Sell cash-secured puts at a lower strike price to generate income and define a potential re-entry level.
notes: Suggest reducing the sell size from 7.5% to 5% to maintain greater exposure to potential upside.

The 'take_profit' at $345 is the target price to rebuy the shares sold, effectively taking profit on the cash position.
